description: Cybersecurity incidents public companies report on Form 8-K, newest first: Item 1.05 (the company judged it material) and, unless excluded, Item 8.01 reports made without that judgment. Each with the company, tickers, filing and event dates, items, state, industry code and the EDGAR filing.

query.description: Company name, ticker, CIK or state.

since.description: Filed on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default 90 days ago; Item 1.05 began 2023-12-18.

until.description: Filed on or before this day. Default today.

name: list_cyber_incident_filings
title: Cyber incidents reported to the SEC
